question: Which is taller, Burj Khalifa or the Shanghai Tower, and what is the height difference in metres?

subquestions: What is the official height (in metres) of Burj Khalifa?
What is the official height (in metres) of the Shanghai Tower?

args.query: Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat Burj Khalifa height 828 m

observations.content:
Summary: The official height of the Burj Khalifa is 828 metres (2,716.5 ft), as announced in a 2009 press release and confirmed by Wikipedia. The tower, designed by Skidmore, Owings & Merrill, is the world's tallest building according to the Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat. The sources also mention that the tower comprises luxury residences and offices, the world's first Armani Hotel, and the world's highest observation deck, 'At the Top', located on the 124th floor.

[1] 'Burj Khalifa' is Unveiled to the World and its Official Height is 828 Metres
    https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/burj-khalifa-is-unveiled-to-the-world-and-its-official-height-is-828-metres-80657972.html
    (Photo:  )

The official height of the tower, unveiled as 'Burj Khalifa', was announced as 828 metres (2,716.5 ft).

'Burj Khalifa', developed by Emaar Properties (), is the world's tallest building according to the three criteria of the Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat: 'Height to Architectural Top', 'Height To Highest Occupied Floor', and 'Height To Tip'. [...] The tower is 320 metres taller than  Taiwan's   Taipei  101, which had held the title of world's tallest building since 2004, the year when the project was announced.

Mohamed Alabbar, Chairman of Emaar Properties, said that the tower represented a symbol of hope to the Arab world and a shining example of human achievement. [...] 'Burj Khalifa' comprises luxury residences and offices, the world's first Armani Hotel, and the world's highest observation deck, 'At the Top', which is located on the tower's 124th floor. Around 90 per cent of the tower's offices and apartments have been sold.

'At the Top' opens officially to the public on  January 5 . The handover of offices and apartments starts in February, and the Armani Hotel Dubai will be opened by its designer,  Giorgio Armani , on  March 18 .

args.query: Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat Burj Khalifa height 828 m

observations.content:
Summary: The Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat recognizes Burj Khalifa in Dubai as the tallest building in the world at 828 m (2,717 ft) with 163 floors. This status was confirmed by the organization in 2010, and it remains the tallest building according to the sources provided. The Burj Khalifa surpassed the previous "World’s Tallest" building, Taipei 101, by 320 meters, an unprecedented increase of 61%. The building also holds records for "Height to Tip" and "Highest Occupied Floor".
